description: This file defines a Blazor component class named BlazorLayoutComponent, which extends LayoutComponentBase and manages refresh logic through an event handler tied to a singleton RefreshBroadcast.

classes.name: BlazorLayoutComponent
classes.description: A Blazor layout component that handles refresh events and triggers UI updates.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overrides the base method to subscribe to the refresh event.

methods.name: CallRequestRefresh
methods.description: Public method to trigger a refresh request via the refresh broadcast.

methods.name: DoRefresh
methods.description: Event handler that invokes StateHasChanged to re-render the component.
